sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 300. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces physical and magic Ability Power by 40 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Grief (10% chance to increase Damage by 50%) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Increases Ability cooldown times by 50% for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Phalanx for 90 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects). Recover 100 Cost and fill your Unison gauge by 30 when this effect is removed).
Only [Hardy Guard] Killiam can be used as Unlocking Potential material
